strings.subject: {name} מחכה לטלפון ממך
strings.heading: יש לך פנייה חדשה מהאתר
strings.intro: מישהו השאיר פרטים באתר של {business}, והוא מחכה שתתקשר אליו עכשיו.
strings.footer: שלחנו לך את ההודעה הזאת כי האתר של {business}, שבנינו ב-WAO, קיבל פנייה חדשה.

why: Angle: speed. He's busy and his hands are dirty, so he needs to see who is waiting and tap the button. Everything pushes him to call now while the customer is still available. The subject puts {name} first so he sees on the lock screen that someone specific is waiting for him. The verb מחכה reads the same for a male or female visitor. The heading says plainly what happened, and the intro adds the urgency with the word עכשיו. It says nothing about what the call will bring. That keeps it away from the ban on results claims and makes no promise on WAO's behalf. I used פנייה, not ליד. It's the word a tradesman uses, and it appears once in the heading and again in the dashboard link, so the thing has one name across the email. The labels are bare nouns, because the placeholders carry the content. The button uses the same plain imperative the site already uses. The footer explains why he got this email in one sentence, with no unsubscribe promise. There are no exclamation marks and no emoji. The brief asked for JSON only, so the angle line sits here instead of above the output.
